prayerExcerpt.en-US: "I am here because of those who break their marriage vows, and those who do not want to see God's work go forward."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Estou aqui por causa dos que quebram os votos do matrimônio e dos que não querem ver a obra de Deus avançar."

meta.face: A Tolai man of New Britain of about thirty-three with a deep, dark-brown complexion and a BROAD, SQUARE face — a wide forehead under thick, tightly curled black hair cut short and standing up a little above the brow, STRAIGHT, heavy black brows set LOW over deep-set dark eyes, a BROAD, flat nose with wide nostrils, full cheeks, a WIDE, full-lipped mouth closed firmly, a rounded, strong jaw; clean-shaven; the gaze grave, gentle and direct. Not the long, sculpted face of charles_lwanga.
meta.basis: His one known photograph (the Dicastery's portrait; the portrait on English Wikipedia): a broad, square face with low, heavy straight brows over deep-set eyes, a broad flat nose, a wide full mouth and short, tightly curled hair, in a white shirt. The Australian Dictionary of Biography and Wikipedia record that he was commissioned catechist of Rakunai in 1933 and given the official catechist's cross.
meta.excerpt: His words in prison, «Sono qui per coloro che infrangono i loro voti matrimoniali, e per coloro che non vogliono vedere l'opera di Dio andare avanti», as the Dicastery's page gives them; a short quotation, our rendering (he died in 1945)
